title: Copies of the held-decision net2 graph, cloned from the fixed rule, before and after holding u
description: Both PPO gates (exp-net2-ppo-gate-99, exp-net2-gate-team-104) found their candidates worse than the fixed rule as copies, by 0.12 to 0.16. Here the untrained clones of the fixed rule (u = 0.25 on net1 v5) run as 2 and 4 copies on the validation links (campaign seed 21, as at the gates) next to the rule and BBRv3: the held-decision graph that holds a decision's window until the next one (every earlier PPO and TD3+BC run), and the one that holds its u and aims each step's window at that step's believed BDP (85de8d0). Both decide as the rule does; any difference is the holding. Policies in release model-net2-clones. Reported: log utility against BBRv3 (experiments/rule_report.py) and the copies' fairness, utilization and queueing delay (experiments/copies_report.py). Validation links only.
prepare: (cd "$IN/c" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); (cd "$IN/m" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 21 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 --policy "rule-v5=$IN/m/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "held-window-clone=$IN/c/held-window-clone.onnx" --policy "held-u-clone=$IN/c/held-u-clone.onnx"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; cp "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" && uv run python experiments/copies_report.py "$OUT"
